primary.label: author proposition environment with its own label proposition-pic-functor (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3222-3232

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: reduces to the case with a section by taking B' = X (surjective flat finitely presented, Picard functor pulls back, representable morphism) and applying the bootstrap theorem; with a section, Picardstack is algebraic (proposition-pic), the sectioned substack is algebraic (compare-pic-with-section + representable-morphism lemma), the kernel functor T -> Ker(sigma_T^*: Pic(X_T) -> Pic(T)) is an algebraic space (with-section-functor-stack lemma + characterize-representable-by-space), and it equals the Picard functor by the with-section lemma (source lines 3241-3271)
